page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores using Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a threads-per-core ratio of 1.0, the instance provides dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring reliance on external block storage for data persistence and CPU-only execution for computational tasks. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers high resource density with a standard general-purpose resource ratio. The dedicated physical core configuration eliminates resource contention from multi-threading, making it suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, large-scale databases, and general-purpose workloads requiring high-throughput network performance and balanced memory-to-CPU allocations.
